calls.video_title: Invest $580 a Month Into These ETFs. Retire a Millionaire
calls.thesis: Dividend-bucket (defensive) pick; SCHD fell only 3.2% in 2022 vs S&P 500 -18.2%; pays cash while held.
calls.bull_case: Defensive tilt raises mix yield and cushions drawdowns as growth weight dials down with age.
calls.bear_case: Dividend funds overlap less with SCHD but still equity risk; growth historically outperforms over long horizons.

calls.video_title: 4 ETFs to BUY for the Rest of 2026
calls.thesis: Quality US dividend ETF (3.2% yield, ~7%/yr growth, ~20% TTM) offsets tech overexposure; ~10% pullback improves valuation. 30% sleeve.
calls.bull: Broadening market leadership and valuation-conscious rotation lift quality dividend payers.
calls.bear: If mega-cap tech keeps cruising, SCHD lags.

calls.video_title: SCHD Just Made a BIG Move — Here's What Changed
calls.thesis: Q3 rebalance raised tech 8.9%->12% with QCOM/TXN now top-2 holdings; still his favorite dividend ETF, continuing to hold.
calls.base_case: Rules-based mean-reversion has added value before (Q2 adds like MRK +28%); dividend income +4.2% YTD.
calls.bull_case: More tech participation without abandoning the dividend mandate; 28% total return vs 17% S&P 500 past year.
calls.bear_case: Rebalance is not a valuation call; prior adds like PEP (-7%) and HD (-7.4%) lagged.
